checks.basis: Kernel isolation is consistent with conflict-only override, but the registered ecological decision-level bitwise B/K/T/H/budget audit was not exported.

R4 crosses genuinely randomized uninformative labels with label-neutral, generic-source and imposed authority-sensitive policies, identical acquired tutor histories and common draws. Unconditional and conflict contrasts are exported. This is a mechanism assay, not evolved authority sensitivity.

R4 runs the full joint-exposure memory-acceptance (0/1) by immediate override (0/.5) factorial with blank states, acquired B/K/T/H, actual budgets, actions and twenty adult reuse steps; adults have zero inherited override. Memory intervention changes storage, not cognitive capacity.
Births blank B/K/T/H and transmit genotype only; no cross-fostering/full relabel audit.
Blank initialization is tested in fixtures, not all registered founder cultures and failed burn-ins.

ExactTinyPOMDP validates only a restricted two-episode toy; IBM Q0 is greedy, FeatureTrust is action-blind, and Candidate B is approximate with mismatched evaluated/executed query accuracy. The overlay repairs the asocial local oracle but does not create a strong general-RL or optimal-planning comparator.

The final resource_control enforces4 tokens/person and closed energy/resource budgets with24 equal-realized-work pairs. The final execution_planner charges12 common abstract deliberation units and actual incremental fees. Global-optimal learner matching and the old pooled upper bound remain unsupported.
Tiny and cognitive landscapes have partial alternatives/coverage; full ensemble and causal prerequisite robustness are incomplete.

The R4 eight-node DAG adds actual branching/recombination, receipt genealogies, held-out physical tests and fresh exactly equal-work pairs. Its solo-protocol energy bound excludes independent completion. Paid two-edge transfer passes23/24; private-only/no-retention/no-bootstrap controls produce no complete programs. Prerequisite scramble has identical endpoints and no separate modification-disabled control ran, so full causal-ablations criterion remains partial.

The final carrier_control removes all people, restarts ten blank agents with audited external energy, disables innovation, and tests costed artifacts on/off over24 fresh pairs. Off retains no recipe; recovered on-origins trace to paid artifacts. This is an intervention, not natural growth.

R4 blank tutors acquire independent .8 private histories; copied testimony shares an actual physical root. Exact enumeration verifies same-root duplication invariance and independent versus explicit hidden-mixture posteriors. The broader ecological merged-root implementation and attribution remain partial.
Schema and grid classes are explicit; sampled-grid classification is descriptive and not a general surface recovery test.
Age threshold tau=5 and adult genetic override off are tested; full life-course confound audit is incomplete.
Material/time ledgers and residual checks pass across frozen and fresh corrected exports.
Teacher eligibility is age-neutral, but the never-updated ranking key resolves by identity and the lexical-first K offer creates a second order artifact; updated performance selection is absent.
Mean N and per-agent-season net resource are exported separately with no scalar-growth relabeling.
Fresh corrected paired neutral-tag finite descendants ran, but not rare-mutant growth or direct competition.
Fresh corrected finite directional contrasts ran; no ESS, fixation, or stable-polymorphism identification.

The final belief_control trains blank learners on a fixed proposition, clones actual states, and gives matched-direction evidence/audience/cost controls under static/switching priors. Factual updating is likelihood-aware; no irrational dogmatism is established. Full normative/source-asymmetry probes remain absent.
Audience/reward probes exist in a separate process; obligation and novel-context injunction were not modeled.
Frozen and corrected replay identities/source snapshots pass, but common-random-number verification is narrower than full registered event identity audits.

The frozen behavioral path fails because a phantom tutor equals hidden z. The separately registered three-method overlay passes the same adversarial no-teacher probe, while broader policy/world truth-firewall coverage remains partial.
No low-density random-projection or branching-growth validation was run.

Primary denominators are preserved. execution_planner adds actual whole-world initial-arbitration purchase/no-teacher/conflict counts, including dead actors; real juvenile label controls retain opportunity denominators. Independent information-history and demographic-ITT claims remain limited.
Reporting tests recompute frozen and corrected hashes, row counts, corrected paired contrasts, all 25 statuses, finite-claim guards, and both frozen-defect/corrected-path probes.

selection_precision.registered_precision_rule: all 12 paired descendant MCSE values <=0.25 and all 24 arm-level establishment Wilson half-widths <=0.10

frozen_local_no_teacher_defect.mechanism: No advice leaves private/teacher Q0 tied at zero; lexical tie-break selects teacher. With no teacher, local-state construction sets the synthetic tutor signal equal to hidden z.
frozen_local_no_teacher_defect.scientific_impact: Asocial local comparisons are invalid. Other ecology/holdout/lineage results are descriptive under an unquantified no-teacher-local contamination until replay exports exposure counts or a corrected frozen variant is run.
frozen_local_no_teacher_defect.repair_boundary: Do not edit frozen/archive bytes or cached primary data; future corrected variant must remove teacher action without a teacher or route it to the private cue and rerun affected ecology evidence.

corrected_local_no_teacher_audit.scope: No-teacher local path only; teacher-present behavior delegates to the frozen base.

limitations: d=0 is ordinary social learning, not asocial or fully deferential.
tau=5 is a fixed age threshold and differs from V1-V6 exponential maturation means; tau was not optimized.
The IBM Q0 is a greedy whole-procedure posterior proxy without a two-episode continuation term; ExactTinyPOMDP is a separate reduced toy.
FeatureTrust predicts reward from source features without action input; Candidate B remains approximate and charges a declared procedure opportunity proxy.
The procedural teacher-ranking key is never updated, leaving an identity-order tie; the offer is the lexical first eligible K sequence, not chosen from updated B or predicted performance.
Population N, per-agent-season net resource, and conditional finite descendants are different estimands.
Frozen no-tutor local decisions contain a confirmed phantom-oracle defect; their ecology and lineage exports are invalidated rather than mixed with the fresh corrected-primary results.

The corrected overlay changes only the three no-teacher local methods; it does not repair lexical teacher selection, action-blind FeatureTrust, Candidate-B evaluator/execution mismatch, or missing purchase/event counts.
Corrected outcomes remain finite, conditional simulation results and do not identify significance, equivalence, biological adaptation, invasion fitness, ESS, fixation, or stable polymorphism.
Wilson precision for action/revision/success rates is unresolved without exported event counts.
Candidate-B information-purchase counts were not exported.
Independent final scientific review is a separate reviewer-owned artifact.
